layout_sources: https://github.com/Yatekii/dinero/blob/main/src/banks/revolut.rs (export rows: TOPUP/CARD_PAYMENT/TRANSFER, Fee column taken off the Balance, a REVERTED row with no Completed Date or Balance, rows in completion order)
https://github.com/BananaAccounting/Universal/blob/master/extensions/import/revolut/ch.banana.uni.import.revolut.js (personal format 1 header and rows; English/German/Italian/French headers)
notes: Rows in the order they completed (oldest first), ISO date-times, signed Amount, a separate Fee that the Balance also takes off (the cash withdrawal: -200.00 with a 2.00 fee, so -202.00 leaves the account), Currency per row, State, and the Balance after each completed row. A REVERTED row has no Completed Date and no Balance, and is not a line of the statement. Started and Completed are the same day on every completed row here, so the line date is not ambiguous. LF, ASCII, no thousands mark.
